hints.title: Balanced Parentheses Analogy
hints.text: Interpret 1 as an opening parenthesis and 0 as a closing parenthesis.

hints.title: Primitive Component Decomposition
hints.text: Decompose the balanced sequence into irreducible primitive components.

hints.title: Lexicographical Sorting
hints.text: Recursively optimize the inner substring of each component stripped of its outer 1 and 0, then sort all top-level components in descending lexicographical order.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Recursive decomposition with string sorting at each balanced nesting level.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Arbitrarily swapping consecutive special substrings without recursive internal maximization fails to find the global lexicographical maximum.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: String slicing and recursion call frames use O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the dyck language structure and sort independent balanced subtrees greedily.
